title: Knee-height fog band, not a fog bath
note: Global fog stays thin and the mist is a separate knee-high tagged layer: a band, not a bath.
intent: Ground mist is a separate thin layer, never a raised global fog density: raising FogExp2 to fake it produces an opaque milky bath that flattens the whole field and hides the lamp pool’s edge (rejected as "washed"), while leaving it out is rejected as "flat void", and both extremes lose. Keep global FogExp2 density ≤ 0.008 for winter exteriors (0.01–0.03 only in near-black interiors) and build the mist as its own layer 0–1.2 m above the ground, opacity ≤ 0.3, with its own tint, sitting visibly below the lamp pool’s edge and the far facade base. The screenshot target is four readable strata: floor / mist band / clear air / sky. Keep the band a separate pass from any volumetric fog so tuning one never erases the other, and wrap any volumetric pass in a try/catch that falls back to the flat exponential fog. GEOMETRY WARNING: never build the band as horizontal planes above the floor in a scene with props — a plane at 0.3–0.8 m intersects every crate and container and reads as 'filled with water up to the middle'. In an arena or interior use a vertical-gradient fog term in the material/shader (density falling with height) or a floor-hugging alpha texture at y ≤ 0.05; keep the plane-stack only for open exteriors with nothing standing in the band, and never additive blending.

check.js: (!scene.fog || !('density' in scene.fog) || scene.fog.density <= 0.008) && count('mist') > 0 && bbox('mist').max.y <= 1.3 && materials('mist').every(m => m.transparent && m.opacity <= 0.3)
check.note: Global FogExp2 density <= 0.008 (winter exterior) and knee mist exists as a separate tagged layer no taller than ~1.2 m with opacity <= 0.3 - a band, not a bath.

port: Lighting-and-atmosphere is one facet: put setupFog() and makeMistBand() in its module (src/lighting.js), tag every mist sheet "mist", and keep the global density and the band’s opacity as two separate constants so the next iteration can move one without touching the other. Verify the four strata in one default-camera screenshot.

evidence.note: Separate thin layer 0–1.2 m, opacity ≤ ~0.3, global FogExp2 ≤ 0.008; floor / mist band / clear air / sky
keep a low ground-fog band as a separate pass from volumetric fog (older 0–2 m, opacity 0.3–0.5 superseded by the tighter rule); try/catch volumetric passes
ground-fog band 0–1.2 m with its own density and tint, distinct from global fog; without it the knee mist never appears
blue-hour checklist (b): a distinct low ground-fog band separating floor from far field
define fog height band (e.g. 0–1.5 m) and falloff in the same pass as the rest of the atmosphere class
